costComplete.description: Every step is priced, so costUsd is the whole cost (true when there were no calls). False: some calls went to a model missing from the price table, so their cost is unknown (not 0); also false when the usage could not be read.

costUsd.description: USD, computed from the price table when each call was made. Only the full cost when costComplete.

testMode.description: Every call was answered by the built-in test analyzer (model "fake:..."), so nothing was charged. False when there were no calls.

step.description: The step currently running, null when none is.

ms.description: Duration in milliseconds, set once the step finished.

maxPixels.description: Maximum width × height of an accepted video.

cropped.description: The frame was cropped around the subject.

rotation.description: Degrees clockwise the source frame was rotated to make it upright (0, 90, 180, 270).

studio.description: Studio-background version of this image; null when the image is not eligible (interior, detail) or the feature is off.

thumbnailUrl.description: 640 px wide JPG, relative to the API base URL.

url.description: Full-resolution JPG, relative to the API base URL.

style.description: studio: painted by an image model around the original car pixels; grey/light/dark: drawn backdrops.

url.description: Full-resolution JPG, relative to the API base URL: …/images/{imageId}/studio/{style}.

chunkSizeBytes.description: Every chunk but the last has exactly this size.

expiresAt.description: The session and its chunks are dropped after this unless another request arrives: 5 minutes after create until the first chunk is stored, then the session TTL after the last request. It may also be cancelled earlier to make room once it has been idle (see createUpload).

model.description: The model that answered; the built-in test analyzer reports "fake:<model>".

priced.description: The model has a price in the price table, or is the free test analyzer ("fake:" prefix). False: real calls to a model without a price, recorded at costUsd 0 although they were billed.

post.description: For files larger than one request may be (e.g. behind Cloudflare's 100 MB body limit). PUT the chunks, then complete. sizeBytes may be up to the domain's maxUploadBytes (else 413 UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE). Counts against the upload rate limit. An open upload holds an upload slot until it is completed, cancelled or idle past expiresAt (5 minutes before its first chunk, then the session TTL after its last request). A client that already has its maximum of open uploads gets its own longest-idle one (idle for 1 minute, no request in flight) cancelled to make room, else 429 RATE_LIMITED; when all upload slots are taken, the longest-idle upload of anyone idle for 5 minutes is cancelled, else 503 SERVER_BUSY. Retry-After says when one can be.

put.description: Raw bytes (application/octet-stream) of chunk index (0-based). Re-sending a chunk replaces it. Every chunk but the last must be exactly chunkSizeBytes: a Content-Length must match it, and a body without one (chunked transfer) must end after exactly that many bytes (else 400 with details {index, expectedBytes, contentLength}). Chunks may be sent in any order and in parallel. A refused chunk's body is read before the answer, so the client can read it.

post.description: Validates the assembled file exactly like POST /jobs (format, decode, duration, resolution) and enqueues the job. 409 UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE lists the missing chunks in details (an older PUT of a chunk that a newer PUT already stored is waited for, at most a few seconds, and then cut off). Afterwards the upload is gone; calling complete again returns the same outcome, except after a 500, which keeps the chunks so complete can be retried.
